description: Source code implementing directory listing management for Bluetooth OTS service, including functions for object record size calculation, encoding, search, initialization, content retrieval, and state checking.

methods.name: dir_list_object_record_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a directory list object record based on its metadata.

methods.name: dir_list_object_encode
methods.description: Encodes a directory list object into a buffer for transmission.

methods.name: bt_ots_dir_list_reset_anchor
methods.description: Resets the search anchor to the beginning of the directory list.

methods.name: bt_ots_dir_list_search_forward
methods.description: Searches forward in the directory list to find the object at a given offset.

methods.name: bt_ots_dir_list_search_backward
methods.description: Searches backward in the directory list to find the object at a given offset.

methods.name: bt_ots_dir_list_search
methods.description: Determines search direction and performs search to locate object at specified offset.

methods.name: dir_list_update_size
methods.description: Updates the current size of the directory listing based on contained objects.

methods.name: bt_ots_dir_list_selected
methods.description: Handles selection of a directory list object, updating anchor and size.

methods.name: bt_ots_dir_list_init
methods.description: Initializes a directory list, creating and setting up the directory listing object.

methods.name: bt_ots_dir_list_content_get
methods.description: Retrieves content of the directory list starting at a specific offset.

methods.name: bt_ots_dir_list_is_idle
methods.description: Checks if the directory list object is in idle state.
